title: Advancing digitization and reducing costs to support a rebound in transportation
summary: The transport and logistics industry relies heavily on the business continuity of global supply chains and the freedom to transport people, goods and services locally and globally. With production decreasing dramatically in key manufacturing hubs, consumer demand falling, borders closing, and airlines, railways and ground transportation modes curtailed, the industry is facing an unprecedented time with far-reaching impacts.
